# E-PM2 film-tables-fix owner camera test

The owner reports five film simulations working in P and ART with the film tables moved out of late-loaded code; the early-start fault it removes is shown by the harness only.

**physical camera; reported pass; partial report; reported hash.**

**Camera:** [Olympus PEN E-PM2](../cameras/epm2.md) · **Project:** [EPM2Mod](../projects/epm2mod.md)

**Firmware:** [E-PM2 firmware 1.6, build 1600](../firmware/epm2-1600.md) · **Mod build:** film-tables-fix

## Procedure and coverage

Before the flash, free-space, op, hook, film, boot and update-path checks passed, and the three film functions ran in a harness with segments 2 and 3 not copied (210 of 210 cases without a fault, where cold-start-fix faults in 50). The owner then used Grainy Film, Gentle Sepia, Dramatic Tone, Key Line and Watercolor in P and ART.

- The five film simulations looked as expected in P and ART; the debug log shows their film codes in the colour stage, five captures, one MF Assist peaking run and sessions ending normally.

## Limits and assumptions

- Starts after 2 minutes off were not repeated for this build; the owner's body never showed the slow start.
- A release of this build carries the release day on the Firmware screen and so has another SHA-256; the hash here is the build as tested.
- One owner; not reproduced by the Atlas.
